isolation-canaries.scope: Exact Node path and SHA-256; verifier launched via /usr/bin/env -i with literal LANG=C, LC_ALL=C, NO_COLOR=1 only, preventing inherited PATH and Node loader settings from reaching Node. SDK-free macOS sandbox positive/negative controls; hashes pin and bind exact worker/canary/profile bytes to subsequent execution/use; 45-second worker limit, 16-KiB aggregate worker output, five-second reap window; outer harness `check --timeout 60` process-group watchdog with 8-KiB per-stream capture. An unaudited exact runtime dependency closure causes truthful NO-RUN before any fixture/listener/canary effect, with all controls unverified. Broad `/System`, `/usr/lib`, and package-store subtree reads are prohibited; if the prerequisite is audited, only exact dependency paths may be allowed. If that prerequisite is audited, tests use synthetic files in an owned /private/tmp root and one supervisor-owned loopback listener with zero-payload local TCP only; no routed/external network attempt; exact-root cleanup. Exit 0 means preflight evaluated and truthful READY_FOR_REVIEW or NO-RUN emitted, not that containment passed. No OpenCode SDK import, user files/config/credentials, registry or external request.
